name: DEPUSDT proxy unprotected approval
summary: The DEPUSDT vault proxy exposed an approval/authorisation entry point with no access control, so the attacker granted itself an allowance over the vault's USDT and transferred the deposits out.
notes: Constructor-time Upgraded event selected the vulnerable DEPUSDT implementation.
Exact USDT transferred from the DEPUSDT proxy to the attacker, valued at stablecoin par. The separate LEVUSDC transaction is a separate incident and is excluded.
